why: The Object.assign and sort rows of the library table as heap transitions in the proof lane. merged: the target returned through a local alias taken after the write, the same heap and the same reference: proved. swapped: the sources swapped, the target unchanged on one side: refuted and witnessed on the graph. sortedCopy: slice(0) for slice(), the same comparator: proved, the sort an uninterpreted stable sort of the items by the comparator's order. sortedDesc: the comparator reversed: unproved, witnessed on the outcome. sortedInPlace: the receiver sorted in place on both sides, 0 + length for length: proved; lane B sees the same reachable graph.
